bullets.title: Searching for Sugar Man
bullets.note: ([Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00B49L7Y4/ref=pv_ag_gcf?cmp=rt_where_to_watch&tag=rottetomao-20), [iTunes/Apple TV](https://itunes.apple.com/us/movie/searching-for-sugar-man/id578634881?cmp=rt_where_to_watch), [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/movies/details?id=J7idcKLbdIY), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J7idcKLbdIY)). I’ve had dozens of friends recommend this over the years, and I finally watched it last night. It’s SPECTACULAR. It was exactly the feel-good pick-me-up that I needed. The film’s accolades include [95% on Rotten Tomatoes](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/searching_for_sugar_man), a BAFTA Award for Best Documentary, and an Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature, just to mention a few. Here’s the official description: “_Searching for Sugar Man_ tells the incredible true story of [Rodriguez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sixto_Rodriguez), the greatest ’70s rock icon who never was. After being discovered in a Detroit bar, Rodriguez’s sound struck two renowned producers, and they signed a recording deal. But when the album bombed, the singer disappeared into obscurity. A bootleg recording found its way into apartheid South Africa, and over the next two decades, he became a phenomenon. The film follows the story of two South African fans who set out to find out what really happened to their hero.” Watch the trailer [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QL5TffdOQ7g).

bullets.title: Why I speak French
bullets.creator: TJ
bullets.note: . I first saw Tanael “TJ” Joachim at the [Gotham Comedy Club](https://www.gothamcomedyclub.com/) ([@gothamcomedy](https://twitter.com/gothamcomedy)) in New York City. He calmly captured the room, and while I was laughing, I realized how great he was at tackling “off-limits” topics. His comedy was really smart. People got very uncomfortable, and I loved every minute of it. His performance at Gotham a few weeks ago was tighter than most of his older clips online, like the sample above. If he continues to refine and has the right management, I think he could be big.

bullets.title: The Collapse of Wild Red Wolves Is a Warning That Should Worry Us All
bullets.creator: Jimmy Tobias
bullets.note: (_The Nation_). Thanks to [Ryan Holiday](https://tim.blog/2020/04/09/ryan-holiday-stoicism/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) ([@RyanHoliday](https://twitter.com/ryanholiday)) for the recommendation. This is a compelling story of a canary in the coal mine: wild red wolves. Even if you’re a hunter, as I am, it’s a critical preview of what’s coming for many other species if we don’t make important changes soon. It’s also a complete case study on many fronts.
